{{Quote|<s></s>''Zaviir-juna'' is the trial that Yuun must complete to advance in the Findsman art. It is a hunt for the greatest Findsman of all: the Zaviir.|Yuun|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Zaviir''' was a figure who was considered the greatest [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]] of all the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In the era of the [[Galactic War]], to become a Findsman, one had to complete ''Zaviir-juna''&mdash;a hunt for the Zaviir.
